Most cloud and security teams struggle with two fundamental questions: What is actually running across our clouds, and what is exposed? As workloads sprawl and AI models deploy faster than ever, critical posture data gets locked inside specialized consoles. Gaps go unseen until they are exploited, and shadow AI leaves teams flying blind.


To solve this visibility challenge, Palo Alto Networks is introducing CLARA Agent.


By connecting Palo Alto Networks Strata Cloud Manager (SCM) directly to Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise, CLARA Agent turns complex cloud security data into clear, conversational insights. SCM powers this integration by consolidating security across environments, automating AI-driven operations to prevent misconfigurations, and continuously enforcing zero-trust policies with real-time threat prevention. Instead of digging through endless dashboards or running manual queries, teams can simply ask plain-language questions directly inside Gemini Enterprise to get immediate, evidence-backed answers.


CLARA Agent, which will be available on Google Cloud Marketplace, provides instant infrastructure discovery, automatically surfaces production AI/ML models alongside unsanctioned shadow AI, and ranks critical vulnerabilities so teams know exactly what is exposed. By bringing security intelligence directly into everyday workplace tools, it democratizes visibility for cloud, platform, and AI teams alike.


> Bringing Palo Alto Networks CLARA Agent to Google Cloud Marketplace will help customers quickly deploy, manage, and grow the AI agent on Google Cloud’s trusted, global infrastructure. Palo Alto Networks can now securely scale and support organizations using its CLARA Agent to enable their security teams to turn cloud security data into conversational insights.


***Vineet Bhan, Director, Security and Identity Partnerships, Google Cloud***


## **Built for Immediate Value and Enterprise Security**


CLARA Agent supercharges your existing investment in Strata Cloud Manager by bringing its rich security telemetry directly into everyday workflows. Greenfield deployments will benefit from additional visibility into their AI and non-AI workloads.


Designed to complement SCM’s robust security architecture, CLARA Agent leverages the open Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to deliver fast, secure, and context-aware responses without requiring additional infrastructure setup. This integration creates a more seamless experience for security teams, empowering them to audit cloud posture, prioritize zero-day vulnerabilities, and secure rapid AI adoption faster and more intuitively than ever before.


## **See CLARA Agent Live at the Security Innovations Forum 2026**


Palo Alto Networks is proud to be a sponsor of the Security Innovations Forum 2026 on September 29 at the Google Event Center MP7 in Sunnyvale, CA. Join Rich Campagna, Senior VP of Products at Palo Alto Networks, and Joshua Haslett, Strategic Technology Partner Manager at Google, on the executive panel,


*"Co-Innovating the Future of Cybersecurity: A C-Suite Perspective"* (10:50 AM – 11:35 AM). They will discuss how agentic platforms are revolutionizing threat response and how organizations can deploy advanced AI agents at scale.


You can also visit the Palo Alto Networks kiosk during the forum to see a live demonstration of CLARA Agent, connect with our experts, and discover how we are co-innovating with Google Cloud to help safeguard agentic AI environments.


## **Get Started**


Visit our booth at Google Cloud’s Security Innovations Forum 2026, or contact your Palo Alto Networks representative to schedule a demo.
